growth_signal.value: Grew its funding from $30M in 2022 to about $102M in a later round, and says it now connects to 150+ exchange venues and trades 1,000+ asset pairs.

raised.value: €94M (about $102M) round, including equity and debt, after an earlier $30M round in 2022

entry.idea: Trading crypto across many different exchanges is fragmented and hard, so Flowdesk built one platform that provides liquidity, market-making and trading services for crypto companies and institutions.
entry.lesson: Get properly licensed and regulated early in a messy new market, so bigger institutional clients feel safe trusting you with their business.
entry.name: Flowdesk

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: Its funding rounds got much bigger over time, growing from $30M in 2022 to about $102M later, a sign of strong momentum.

market.reason: Institutional crypto trading and liquidity is a real and growing market worldwide, but it is still a niche compared to mainstream finance.

tech.reason: It built its own trading and liquidity infrastructure across many exchanges, solid engineering that a strong, well-funded team could still match in a year or two.

entry.twist: It runs a full trading and technology stack, its own execution algorithms, an OTC trading desk and a ventures arm, rather than just being a broker, and it is a licensed, regulated firm in both Europe and Dubai.
entry.who_pays: Crypto exchanges, token issuers and financial institutions that need liquidity and trading infrastructure for digital assets.
entry.why_now: New crypto rules in Europe (MiCA) and Dubai (VARA) are now being enforced, and demand for institutional-grade crypto trading and liquidity keeps rising.
